# Interactive Kabbalah

> Interactive maps for studying the Kabbalistic Tree of Life, the Rider-Waite tarot and alchemical symbols. Free, no sign-up, available in Portuguese (pt-BR), English (en-US), Hebrew (he) and Japanese (ja).

Content is educational and symbolic. Every page exists in the four languages under `/{locale}/...`.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://interactive-kabbalah.netlify.app/pt-BR): portal with every study area.
- [Tree of Life](https://interactive-kabbalah.netlify.app/pt-BR/arvore-da-vida): the 10 Sephirot, the 22 paths and the Qliphoth (Tree of Death) in an interactive, pan-and-zoom map.
- [Rider-Waite Tarot](https://interactive-kabbalah.netlify.app/pt-BR/tarot): the 22 major arcana with symbol-by-symbol readings and Golden Dawn correspondences (Hebrew letter, planet, sign, element).
- [Alchemical Symbols](https://interactive-kabbalah.netlify.app/pt-BR/simbolos-alquimicos): catalog of the Unicode alchemical symbols with copy-to-clipboard.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://interactive-kabbalah.netlify.app/sitemap.xml): every localized URL with hreflang alternates.
